Alvora Diamonds

Alvora Diamonds is a laboratory-grown diamond business based in Surat, India. Its documented site content covers wholesale laboratory-grown diamonds for jewellery retailers, manufacturers, designers, and other trade buyers, including loose stones, calibrated layouts, matched pairs, melee, fancy shapes and colours, and custom-cut requirements. The available company-specific source material does not establish a public capacity figure, team size, or universal service level.

Live inventory
Current Production Availability: /availability
Alvora publishes its current loose lab-grown diamond stock at /availability, open to any visitor with no account or sign-in. Listings cover the White and Fancy Colour collections plus the STATEMENT collection, and every published stone carries a matching report from the named laboratory: IGI links resolve to igi.org and GIA links to gia.edu, each containing the listed report number. Each listing gives stock number, collection, shape, carat and carat band, colour, clarity, cut, polish, symmetry, fluorescence, measurements, depth, table, ratio, laboratory and certificate number, with supplied 360 degree media where it exists. Prices are not published; specifications are quoted on request against a stated brief. French and Italian views of the same catalogue are at /fr/availability and /it/availability.
